gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At the 2024 year end Syndicate 1910 opened with gross claims outstanding of GBP 448.1m. The Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 45.34m (10.1% of opening gross reserves), driven by favourable claims development primarily in longer-tail and specialty classes (noted improvements on 2021 & 2022). The overall 2024 calendar-year results were adversely affected by a series of 2024 catastrophe events (including Florida landfalling hurricanes such as Helene and Milton and the Baltimore bridge allision) and a high level of global catastrophe activity; a post-balance sheet Los Angeles wildfire event (Jan 2025) was noted as likely to materially affect 2024/2025 years of account.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate has seen improvement in its prior year reserves for 2021 & 2022, due to good experience on its longer tail and specialty classes.

Consideration has been made within the 2022 year of account reinsurance to close for some multi year exposure to the devastating wildfires in Los Angeles in January of 2025. This event will also materially impact the 2024 and 2025 years of account in the 2025 calendar year.
